explanation: One of Israel's judges, known for his supernatural strength that came from his long hair.
A people in Canaan who were enemies of the Israelites and controlled parts of the land at that time.
A Philistine woman whom Samson loved and who betrayed him by getting him to reveal the source of his strength.
An architectural structure that supports a building; Samson collapsed two pillars in the Philistines' temple and killed many enemies along with himself.
A religious vow that some Israelites took, which included abstaining from alcohol, avoiding contact with dead bodies, and not cutting one's hair.
The source of Samson's strength; he lost his power when Delilah had it cut off.
The condition Samson ended up in after the Philistines captured and blinded him.
The act Samson carried out against the Philistines by destroying their temple and killing many of them along with himself.
